contract: construct() -> 16 distinct integers in 1..200. The score is min over theta of sum cos(a*theta), divided by sqrt(16), computed by dense sampling of the full circle and golden-section refinement of the deepest local minima (accuracy about 1e-9). Maximize (make the minimum as shallow as possible).
